\caption{Knowing where vs. drawing the outline (E1, zero-shot, T-text channel). (a) Qwen3.5 0.8B–9B (blue) and InternVL3.5 2B/4B (orange, cross-family reference). Knows where: grounding Acc@0.5 on all RefCOCO/+/g evaluation splits (n=56,857) and the model's own predicted box rasterised as a mask (cIoU, n=200 expressions). Draws the outline: free-form polygon cIoU (n=8,000), 16$\times$16 grid gIoU (n=500) and structure-forced polygon cIoU ($\geq$3 vertices; n=200, the same expressions as the own box; run for Qwen3.5 only, n/a for InternVL3.5). Strict readings: invalid answers score 0. Error bars: 95\% bootstrap CI (1,000 resamples). (b) Paired difference structure-forced polygon $-$ own box on the same expressions ($\geq$3 and $\geq$8 vertices), 95\% paired bootstrap CI; 8 of 8 CIs exclude 0. Gemma-4-E2B, Gemma-4-E4B are omitted: their grounding answers are mostly refusals (valid answers: Gemma-4-E2B 20\%, Gemma-4-E4B 25\%), so both knows-where readings measure refusal rather than localisation.}
